summary: Tested the frontend only, at 390x844 web with mocked geolocation, on the LOCAL TEST-0001 load. The load was reset before and after; the remote naughty-hugle-13 backend was not touched. The Start ride / zone timer / End ride flow passed. Paste link + Open load leads to driver-start-button labeled 'Start ride'. There is no driver-arrived-button or driver-departed-button, and no 'at the dock' / 'I'm leaving' text. Start at 41.88,-87.63: driver-ride-time counted 00:00:00 -> 00:00:02, driver-zone-idle was shown, there was no zone timer and no arrival, and the start card was hidden. Entering pickup: driver-zone-timer appeared within about 1 s of the ping, showing 'IN ZONE FOR · MIDWEST DISTRIBUTION CENTER', a counting driver-zone-time and 'Free time left 01:59:59'. The toast 'Entered zone · Midwest Distribution Center' appeared and the main timer kept counting without resetting. Reloading mid-ride kept the original start (00:05 -> 00:08), with no start card, the zone timer still visible and GPS re-attached. Moving about 1 km away: the zone timer went away, the toast 'Left zone · Midwest Distribution Center · 0m in zone' appeared, the stop showed In/Out times, the main timer kept running and delivery became the current stop. Delivery in and out behaved the same, with both toasts. After all stops: note bolToFinish, then after the BOL upload it changed to 'All stops are done. Tap End ride below...'. Tracking was NOT auto-stopped after the BOL (pings 6->7). The End ride sheet's Keep tracking option leaves tracking on. Confirm: 'Trip time · ended 3:45 AM', the timer is frozen, End ride is hidden, the GPS chip shows 'Tracking finished', the start card is NOT shown, no pings are sent after ending (5->5), and the ended state survives a reload. Spanish was checked for Iniciar viaje, Terminar viaje, the start card, 'Tiempo de viaje · inició/terminó', 'EN ZONA POR', zoneWaiting, the toasts 'Entraste a la zona' / 'Saliste de la zona ... en zona', allDoneP and 'Rastreo terminado'. Reset test trip from the UI brings the start card back. Deprecated packages: none detected (no expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch).

ui_bugs.issue: These strings still say 'Start trip' while the button is now 'Start ride': gpsIdle 'Tap Start trip to share your location' (i18n.ts:39) and resetDone '...press Start trip to try again' (i18n.ts:126). The leftover EN endTrip 'End trip (stop recording)' at i18n.ts:118 looks unused.

The EN/ES copy says 'Tracking stays on until it's attached', but tracking no longer auto-stops after the BOL (verified: pings continue and End ride is still required). This misleads drivers. Reference: i18n.ts:117 and the ES string at :242.

action_items: Update the EN gpsIdle and resetDone strings from 'Start trip' to 'Start ride'.
Change the bolToFinish EN/ES copy so it no longer says tracking stops when the BOL is attached (e.g. 'Last step: attach the photo of the signed BOL below, then tap End ride.').

Optional: in the zone toast effect ([token].tsx:105-112), a stop that gets both arrived_at and departed_at in one payload (e.g. after an offline queue flush) only fires the 'Entered' toast; consider firing both or only 'Left'.
critical_code_review_comments: If the driver taps End ride while inside a zone, that stop's departed_at is never stamped (tracking stops, so no departing ping). The server-side dwell/detention for that stop may stay open; consider stamping departure on End ride or warning in the sheet.

Once a ride has ended, a real (non-test) load has no way to restart tracking (the start card is hidden while ride.endedAt exists). The confirm sheet mitigates this, but an accidental end cannot be undone by the driver.
Not verified: the 'Ride ended' toast after confirming. It was not found about 5 s after confirm, probably because it had already disappeared. All other end-state assertions passed.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of requested flows (2 low-priority copy issues)

seed_data_creation: None. TEST-0001 was reset before and after (final state: both stops have no arrived/departed timestamps and bol_count 0).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the LOCAL TEST-0001 token 15fea12a... Pickup is 41.525,-88.0817 and delivery is 34.049,-117.435 (r300); 'leave' is lat +0.009. Geofence stamps arrive within about 1 s of a set_geolocation move (more than 25 m moved triggers an immediate ping). The End ride sheet is a slide Modal: wait about 1.2 s after it appears before clicking the confirm button, otherwise you get 'Element is outside of the viewport'. Ride state lives in localStorage dockclock.ride.<token>, so each browser_automation call starts fresh.
